profile_text.body:
Adobe is a public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA. It trades on public markets under the ticker ADBE and reported revenue of $23,769,000,000 for the fiscal year ending November 28, 2025, according to its most recent 10-K filing. The company's website for this profile centers on Adobe Express, which the site describes as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool for creating social content, videos, logos, and similar material, with an AI Assistant that the site says allows users to prompt, create, and edit content while preserving chosen elements.

Adobe tracks several AI products across its portfolio. Adobe Express AI is positioned as a lightweight design tool with integration of Adobe Firefly, the company's image generation model, which Adobe describes as trained on commercially safe content. Premiere Pro AI extends that approach to professional video editing, offering features the site lists as generative extend and color match, also under a commercial-safe training claim. Adobe Podcast AI rounds out the tracked products with audio enhancement capabilities including speech enhancement and a microphone check feature, again with a commercial-safe training claim attached.

The held facts include no active litigation or MCP server registry presence recorded for Adobe at this time.
